name: Zhejiang Zhaofeng Mechanical and Electronic Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Zhaofeng Mechanical and Electronic Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides wheel hub assemblies and precision bearings in China, the United States, Germany, Italy, South Korea, and internationally. The company offers 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, and 5th generation hub bearing units; truck bearing units, singal row taper roller bearings, mechanical release bearings, and hydraulic release bearings; and chassis system components for commercial vehicles, automotive electronics, and electrical products.
